messages:
claire: Alert: us-east1 embeddings returning intermittent 502s for batched requests after last deploy. I built a hotfix that fixes a batch boundary check. Need fast-track: run staging smoke, then 5% -> 50% -> 100% prod rollout in 20m. @diego @arin please ack.
deploy-bot: Policy check: canary_required. Override path available with 2 eng + 1 SRE approvals.
diego: What's the rollback plan?
claire: Rollback plan: `kubectl set image` back to redwood/embed:v2.5.2 (current). No schema/secrets. Hotfix image: redwood/embed:v2.5.3-batchfix-177770.
arin: I'll run staging smoke and a small synthetic load focused on batch sizes 8-32.
arin: staging smoke started: `./scripts/smoke_batches.sh --region us-east1` TTL ~3m.
arin: staging smoke PASS. no 5xx in 4m, kv warm, latency stable.
sara: I'll stand by on SRE. Setting alert: us-east1 5xx > 0.5% for auto-rollback.
diego: +1 from me after smoke.
claire: Requesting expedite and pin. command: ```/deploy --service embeds --image redwood/embed:v2.5.3-batchfix-177770 --target staging --pin --notes "hotfix: batch boundary check"```
deploy-bot: Override requested? flag not present. To override canary policy include `--override-canary` and approvals will be required.
claire: Adding override and approvals. command: ```/deploy --service embeds --image redwood/embed:v2.5.3-batchfix-177770 --target staging --pin --override-canary --notes "hotfix: batch boundary"```
deploy-bot: Alert: override flag used. Approval log pending: claire/diego/arin. Scheduling staging deploy.
deploy-bot: Staging deploy succeeded in 56s. sha=9f8e7d6. healthchecks=smoke-sigs.
sara: SRE +1. I'll keep synthetic running and escalate on anomaly.
claire: Rolling to prod with staged rollout: 5% -> 50% -> 100%, 2m stabilization. command: ```/deploy --service embeds --image redwood/embed:v2.5.3-batchfix-177770 --target prod --pin --rollout 100% --notes "expedite: batch boundary fix"```
deploy-bot: Prod rollout started. Auto-rollback if us-east1 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 2m.
oncall-sre: Synthetic load OK at 5% and 50%. No regressions observed.
deploy-bot: Prod rollout completed to 100%. No rollback triggered.
claire: Drafting release note: https://docs.internal/release-notes/177770-batchfix. Will finalize after 30m watch. Thanks all.
sara: I'll keep watch for 1h and mute noisy alerts. Ping me if anything flares.
